title: PURSUE UAP Document Dataset
description: Structured AI analysis and page-by-page machine transcription of every document in the U.S. government's PURSUE (Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters) declassified UFO/UAP releases on war.gov/UFO, with links to the official originals. Transcriptions and structured fields are machine-generated (Claude) from the official PDFs and labelled as such; every row keeps the link to its source document. Column documentation: SCHEMA.md. Browse and cite: https://uapinsight.com/pursue/data
